generated code, so this says whether a fold is on-system rather than whether it
happens to look right. scripts/_library_site.py maps each path onto a --gw-* token
and re-checks the value against foundation/tokens.css on EVERY build — so a token
that moves in one place and not the other shows up as drift without anyone
